title: IEC 60034-14:2026 — Mechanical vibration of certain rotating electrical machines
locator: Official publication catalogue and scope statement for factory acceptance vibration tests
notes: Scope-limited factory vibration acceptance method for certain uncoupled electrical machines: DC/three-phase AC, shaft heights at least 56 mm, rated output up to 50 MW and operating speed 120–15000 min-1. Excludes machines mounted in situ and magnetic-bearing machines among other exclusions. It is not a torque-ripple standard and must not be applied by default to an integrated low-speed torque-motor rotary axis.
